title: timing / driver.checked_in (v1) data payload
description: A driver identified at the entry gate (check-in). Published to the 'timing.events' exchange with routing key 'driver.checked_in'. QR codes embed the masterId (read directly, no lookup); transponders carry a hardware id resolved via Timing's local transponder->masterId map.

masterId.description: Canonical masterId issued by Identity. Lowercase canonical UUID v4 (version nibble 4, variant nibble [89ab]); the pattern is enforced (format is annotation-only). Read directly from the QR, or resolved from the transponder map. Timing never mints it.

at.description: When the gate scan happened. RFC3339 UTC, exactly 3-digit milliseconds, literal 'Z' (AR9). The pattern is enforced (format is annotation-only).

checkInMethod.description: How the driver was identified at the gate: 'qr' (masterId read directly from the QR, no lookup) or 'transponder' (hardware id resolved via Timing's local map).

transponderId.description: The hardware id when checkInMethod is 'transponder'; null for QR drivers. Always present (no omitempty on a meaningful wire field, AR9).
